This paper thus aims to introduce a method to reduce the number of accidents due to drowsy driving. Using an Electroencephalograph (EEG) headset which consists of multiple EEG sensors and inbuilt Bluetooth transmitter, brain wave data is transmitted to the system. The collected data is fed as input to the prediction model which decides whether the driver is being drowsy or not. The prediction model is trained by using the Auto Regressive and Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) time series algorithm to predict whether the person is being drowsy. If so, the proposed system can be used to trigger an alarm/warning mechanism.

articleTitle: A Look Over on Prosperous Power Electronic Converters for Wind Turbine System
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper essentially an introduction of power electronic and its appliances with the assertion on wind turbine systems. There is the far-reaching stretch use of wind turbines for power generation technologies. So progressively more power electronics stand-in as an intensity plant are connected instantly to the transmission and distribution systems. The tolerable induction generator is placed a vital role in power networks, prosperous power electronics systems and rein in methods declare to be introduced to get better efficiency of wind turbine system. This paper gives an analysis of suitable power electronic multilevel converter topologies for the latest wind energy system has been discussed with generators. As well as the corresponding power electronics converters are the reviewed and compared, current matrix converters more suitable technologies for renewable energy sources conversion and control purpose.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power Wireless Sensor for Reducing Wiring Complexity of Aircraft Engine Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The complexity of a modern aircraft engine is ever increasing as a result of the attempts to enhance its reliability by encouraging the use of more number of redundant components in order to ensure safe operation of the engine. The high reliability design of an engine control unit such as a full authority digital engine control (FADEC) with excessive use of redundant sensors is posing a challenge of wiring these sensors. The present research work carried out in association with the gas turbine research establishment, under defence research development organization focuses on the implementation of wireless sensors for enhancing the reliability of engine control system and reducing the complexity by many folds. A low power wireless sensor is designed and fabricated with data management and multi node communication architecture to eliminate the wiring complexity of the FADEC systems.

articleTitle: Image Processing based forensic investigation of morphed documents
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This being the age of digitization, the rates of cyber-crimes has been surging prodigiously. With people carrying their IDs around with them, one would think it would be difficult to pose as someone else in a public setting. However, it has been proven incredibly easy to create fake documents with powerful photo editing soft-wares being as pervasive as ever. Documents can be scanned and forged within minutes with the help of these soft-wares that have tools readily available just to do that. While photo manipulation software is handy and ubiquitous, there are also means to deftly investigate these morphed documents. This paper lays a foundation on investigation of digitally manipulated documents. No public databases have been used for analysis. The entire database used in this paper has been created solely for the purpose of studying the forensic investigation of illegal documents. Then, analysis was done on this self-created dataset using image processing algorithms and later, discriminatory results were studied.

articleTitle: Survey on Cognitive Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Wireless sensors which are used for sensing any event can be made intelligent by adding cognitive sensors. Cognitive agents are capable of making proactive choices according to the current situation based on the requirement needed in a WSN, to achieve the end to end goals of the network deployed even during the complex situation and with constraints scenario. The cognitive layer can be added to any network deployed in any application environment and it can be made intelligent. The cognitive sensor is a recent technology, and this literature survey reviews how cognitive layer has been implemented in various applications. Energy loss is one of the major impediments in all WSNs. This literature survey shows how energy efficiency can be minimized.

articleTitle: eNodeB configuration, performance and fault management for coverage optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: As the demand for LTE networks keeps on increasing day by day the necessity to improve the service with the current available infrastructure is one of the key measures to be taken into consideration. The initial configuration set up, the performance of the system once installed and the rectification of faults all play a major role in this process. This paper discusses the configuration, performance and fault management of eNodeBs in the current LTE environments and then a NetSim simulation based study is presented on the concept of coverage optimization considering relays. The throughput and delay is analyzed for various scenarios. Using relays is an option for overcoming coverage hole issue as proved in the paper.

articleTitle: Integrating the Extreme Programing Model with Secure Process for Requirement Selection
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In this paper we basically compare the various agile project management development models. And also try to recognize the element that can make the project to vulnerabilities during the project development. The agile development methodologies can be done by following the main principle of that the software requirements always change with the change of time. We will also try to learn the frameworks on which the methodologies of agile software development were based like Scrum, XP & DSDM. In this paper we will try to improve the XP framework by adding the security processes and will also compare with the previous model.

articleTitle: Design of Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm: Leeway to UMTS system
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Computational intelligent techniques one of emerging field of research within research community. Numerous proposals have already been implemented in two interesting computational intelligent techniques namely fuzzy logic and neural network. However, findings of optimum values have not been achieved by adopting these two approaches. To solve this issue various optimization techniques have been suggested. For this purpose, physics based, swarm based and human based optimization algorithms have been recommended. Moreover, it has also been noticed that one of the renowned communication schemes like Universal Mobile Telecommunications System (UMTS) has been enormously used in different field of wireless communication. An exhaustive research has also been executed on this field for further improvement. In this article, modification of a stimulating technique entitled as Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) has been executed “bubble-net” confronting process. To evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithm numerous benchmark functions has been considered. Finally, proposed Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm (IWOA) has been applied on UMTS technique. In this framework, Bit Error Rate (BER) performance of the enriched UMTS standard has also been analyzed using existing Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) and its modified version.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Speckle Filters by Using Polarimetric Synthetic Aperture Radar Data Through Local Statistics
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Speckle noise, a granular noise, occurs in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data due to the interference of reflected signals with several scatterers in a resolution cell. One of the simplest techniques to suppress speckle noise from polarimetric SAR data is to use local statistics. The Lee filter employs sample mean and variance of pixels of data degraded by speckle noise, which can be multiplicative, additive, or a mixture of both, in a searching window. The refined Lee method utilizes directional windows with local minimum mean square error (LMMSE), which ensures superior maintenance of spatial resolution and features. The Lee-Sigma filter is constructed on the basis of the two-sigma probability, which effectively suppresses the speckle noise. However, insufficiencies were observed in the generation of a biased evaluation, blurring of edges, and suppression of point targets. To eliminate these insufficiencies, the improved Lee-Sigma filter was developed, which employs the minimum mean square error estimate as a priori mean. Thus, an excellent maintenance of point targets and subtle details is displayed. In this study, the Lee, refined Lee, Lee-Sigma, and improved Lee-Sigma filters were evaluated using full polarimetric data. The evaluated results indicated that the improved Lee-Sigma filter performed better than other local statistics filters.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Approach for Determining Breast Cancer Using Mammography Images
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In females the most common reason for death nowadays is breast cancer. From past few years CAD (computer aided diagnosis) has gained its popularity in detection of breast cancer. Application of image processing technique in medical field has been increasing day by day. This results in new inventions in diagnosing disease accurately. Accuracy obtained by radiologist in classification of breast cancer may tend to decrease when dealing with large volume of images. This paper proposes a method for classification of breast cancer based on three categories, twelve classes and six shapes. This study shows the outcome of applying image processing operation like, preprocessing, segmentation and feature extraction. Proposed work uses random forest classifier as classification technique and proven to achieve high accuracy when compare to support vector machine classifier.

articleTitle: Patterns Generation of Horizontal Dipole Array Embedded in Different Dielectric Slabs
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A number of papers are available on the analysis of dipole arrays in free space. But the work on embedded dipoles in dielectric media is limited in open literature. The behavior and characteristics are completely changed when the dipoles are embedded in dielectric slab. In this paper horizontal dipole array embedded in different dielectric slabs and different slab thickness is considered. Based on which, and radiation patterns are generated. Such patterns are used in point-to-point communications, scan, and non-scan radar applications.

articleTitle: Securing Data at rest using Hill Cipher and XOR based operations
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In today's internet based application scenario ensuring database security and ownership rights protection is a major issue because unauthorized acees to data may lead to a huge loss for the organization. Data stored in the database is asset for any organization, so proper secuity mechanism is needed that safeguards from various data attackers. with the target of providing relational database security solution, We have proposed a novel encryption-decryption methodology based on Hill-cipher technique and XOR based opertaion for securing data stored in the database and then explain the process of performing the query. The complete mechanism of security should be time efficient so that it can be used practically. We also compute the time required to perform encryption and decryption for select and update queries against the various numbers of records and listed out experimental result.

articleTitle: Control and Grid Synchronization of Fuel Cell Based Inverter Using Matlab
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Renewable power generation is gaining more important for stand-alone as well as in the form of grid connected distributed generation due to increasing the electrical power demand and requirement of pollution control. Fuel-cell-based power generation is also gaining popularity in residential applications as well as distributed power generation due to its cleanliness, portability, and suitability for electricity and heat generation compared to conventional energy source and some of the non-conventional sources as well. This paper is presented the modeling controlling and synchronization of fuel cell based distributed system. The detailed dynamic modeling of proton exchange membrane fuel cell based DG plant is described. The control strategy is designed for operating the FC based system in both grid connected mode and islanded mode to better work of the system. The design of PEMFC and control system is designed and simulated using MATLAB/Simulink software.

articleTitle: CPU Core Optimization in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Cloud computing has been on the scale of becoming a dire technology in today's world. With the augmenting demand of the cloud resources it is very pressing concern to enhance the cloud architecture for higher efficiency. Former optimization systems concentrated either on dynamic electricity switching or Real Time Virtual Machines[2] which did not utilize the intact capacity of hosts. The contemplated system considers the administrator point of view and helps in increase in revenue generation by stocking the resources to the optimum level. Dynamic Core Recommendation averts any kind of extravagance of resources. Detailed analysis and a better training model will recommend to the administrators and user so as to aid both parties.

articleTitle: Improved Matching Technique in Digital Image Region Duplication
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Region duplication is the common type of image tampering which copies a part of an image and moved in that same image. Many techniques have been proposed to detect such tampering but it is difficult to find the true matched region in an image. Over many existing methods SIFT considered to be efficient one in matching duplicated region under different kinds of transformations, but fails when the image has reflection in it. A method with capability of detecting duplication under reflection is used in this work to make a detection system even more accurate and efficient.

articleTitle: High Accuracy Star Sensor for Indian Regional Navigational Satellite Segment “NAVIC”
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: ISRO has successfully launched series of satellites for Indian Regional Navigation Satellite Segment named as NAVIC, which consists of a constellation of SEVEN satellites launched into Geo Stationary (GEO) and Geo Synchronous (GSO) orbits. The pointing and thermal management of the payload require continuous attitude steering of the satellites. This requires autonomous attitude determination and control. To meet these requirements a new MPP CCD based high accuracy low mass star sensor with an accuracy of 10” with an update rate of 8Hz was designed and developed. This paper describes about the design aspects of the Star sensor flown on-board NAVIC satellites and its performance.

Author Keywords: Multi Phase Pinned (MPP) Charge coupled device (CCD)

articleTitle: Human Biometric Identification through Brain Print
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Hidden biometrics features may induce identification of a human being without using the visual structural features. The chances of forgery are reduced substantially through hidden biometrics. We are exploring the capabilities of brain structure to be used as biometric. For this we have estimated uniqueness between the structural features of human brains corresponding to different subjects. So qualifying and quantifying the uniqueness in structure of the brain should lead to subject identification. Subject identification has been done by the brain print extracted from brain structures. The proposed approach is reliable than brain signals based biometric techniques. Our aim is to extract non-linear curves having approximate brain structural information instead of considering brain to be of predefined abstract regular shapes. The results are optimistic as we are able to extract enough number of brain curves from a securely selected slice from complete brain map ensuring the scalability of the approach.

articleTitle: Global Placement for Large-scale Mixed-size Design VLSI Circuits using Plant Model
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Placers which only consider wire-length minimization may produce irresolvable routing-congested placement solution for VLSI circuits. Placement with routability approach is more realistic with current large problems. Therefore, it is required to develop in early stage an effective routability driven global placement algorithm for modern mixed sized circuit. This paper introduce a new and modern routability driven global placer inspired by the resource allocation and patterns in the plants. We mimic the resource allocation technique of the plants to various parts of it, in VLSI circuit placement problem. We present routability driven global placement in two stages. First, selecting suitable nets to place based on strength of net. Second, finding suitable bins for higher order nets to gets place while avoiding congestion. Result shows that at early stage we can reduce the congestion and hence provide an incentive for the later stages- Detailed placement. We performed our experiment on ISPD 2011 benchmark circuits and compared our HPWL and overall congestion with ISPD'11 contestants, Ripple, mPL11, SimPLR.

articleTitle: Causes & Effects of delay in HILS of Aerospace systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Complex embedded systems can be developed and evaluated using a testing technique which is used increasingly known as Hardware In Loop Simulation (HILS). HIL simulation provides an effective platform for real time embedded systems development and testing. The seeker based target acquisition and guidance system is also included in the HILS test bed for its evaluation of real time dynamic performance. The Flight Motion Simulator (FMS) is used to simulate the angular rates excitation to subsystems like seeker and sensors which are mounted on it. All the systems in the HILS test bed creates a considerable delay during simulation runs. This delay leads to divergence in the HILS results. This paper describes the study of causes for the delay in HILS test bed and the effect of this delay in HILS results.

articleTitle: CPW-fed Circularly Polarized Wideband Slotted Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A compact CPW-fed circularly polarized wideband slotted antenna is presented in this electronic document applicable for satellite and wireless applications. The design has a simple uniplanar configuration because of the use of CPW-fed, and has a asymmetric wide slotted ground plane which causes circular polarization and a zigzag shaped stub protruding inside it cause antenna to cover a wideband range. The proposed antenna is designed and simulated using ANYSS HFSS simulator software. The simulated -10[dB] return loss impedance bandwidth is 101.01 %(2.06 GHz-7.34 GHz) with solution frequency 5.24 GHz. The proposed antenna possesses a good circular polarization with wide axial ratio bandwidth 72 %(2.05 GHz-5.83GHz).

articleTitle: Design & Simulation of Coaxial Couplers for X-band TWT
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a co-axial coupler which includes an impedance transformer, coaxial window and a transition to Sub Miniature version-A connector (SMA) for X-band Helix TWTs. The analytical design has been carried out for the window and the step impedance transformer. These are further optimized using the commercially available 3D electromagnetic simulation software package CST. The cold test measurements have also been carried out for the coupler along with the helix. The VSWR, which indicates the matching of the Slow Wave Structure and the coupler, is found to be 1.1, which is within the required and designed limits of 1.2. Based on the values obtained, the dimensions of the coupler were finalized for fabrication.

articleTitle: Application of Data Analytics to predict and analyse COPD Data
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Data Analytics is a state of art technology which can be used in various domains. This paper concentrates on implementation and application of analytics in health care domain. Data present in various forms and formats are collected and integrated into a single system. A rule based algorithm is developed and implemented to predict the presence of the disease. The severity of the disease among the patients is predicted and the accuracy of the algorithm is also measured. The results of the analysis are depicted using various charts among the male and female patients.

articleTitle: A New Audio Watermarking Algorithm with DNA Sequenced Image Embedded in Spatial Domain Using Pseudo-Random Locations
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With increasing amounts of digital audio content creators, there is a need for ownership assertion to be stronger. In this work, we have proposed a new algorithm for embedding a creator-provided image inside an audio signal. The algorithm distorts the image using DNA-Encoding and DNA Addition, followed by symmetric encryption based on AES, prior to embedding in pseudorandom LSB positions of the discrete audio signal. The proposed algorithm is implemented and tested with standard benchmark images. The results obtained are analyzed with the following metrics namely PSNR, MSE and NCC. It has produced an imperceptible audio and can be claimed to provide a robust watermarked audio that can survive against signal processing attacks hence more desirable and appropriate for many practical applications that demands copyright protection features.

articleTitle: Bit Error Rate Analysis of Pre-Coding Techniques in Different MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: MIMO is an important technique in wireless communication which increases data rate and reliability of system and different from smart antenna technology. Due its advantages like easy handling and adaptability wireless communication results increase in link capacity, spectral efficiency, data rates and performance. Pre-coding is a beam forming technique used to achieve transmission diversity and also to predict the channel conditions at the transmitter. Linear and non linear decoding techniques are performed at the receiver side of the MIMO systems. Zero forcing (ZF), Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE), Block Diagonalisation (BD) and Successive Interference Cancellation (SIC) are different techniques used in pre-coding. QPSK modulation scheme is considered in this system to analyze the bit error rate and signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Elliptical Curve Cryptography for Images Using Fractal Based Multiple Key Hill Cipher
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Ever since the evolution of time, there have been changes in the transmission and storage of images, but the only constants are the security issues that came along. Eavesdropping is the major pivotal security challenge and throughout the evolution of time even though many encryption methods are developed, the middlemen and hackers etc. also developed new methods, simultaneously, to sniff the information. In this process of eavesdropping, there are many different methods like chosen-cipher text attack, brute force attack etc. In order to cope up with these deficiencies, we proposed an improvised version of the Elliptical curve cryptography (ECC) with multiple keys generated by fractals. Keys which are generated by the combination of ECC and Fractals are used for the conversion of the symmetric Hill Cipher encryption to asymmetric, which has higher security. In order to measure the efficiency of proposed algorithm we have used the entropy, peak to signal noise ratio(PSNR), unified average changing intensity(UACI) and the correlation between pixels along horizontal, vertical and diagonal directions.

articleTitle: Defending Selective Forwarding Attacks in Underwater Acoustic Networks Applying Trust Model
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Underwater Acoustic Networks (UAN) are formed by acoustically connected ocean-bottom sensors, autonomous vehicles that function underwater in tandem with a surface station to provide a link to an on-shore control center. Applications that deploy them require long-term monitoring of the deployment area. The safety and security of such networks should be guaranteed in the light of Denial of Service (DoS) attack a class of attack that commonly targets them. A specific kind of DoS attack termed as selective forwarding is considered and an improved solution to defend such attack is proposed and analyzed for its efficiency.

articleTitle: Sensors in Transportation for Security Using RFID
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Potential advantages of IoT in the business world incorporate area following, message caution, fuel reserve funds from wise condition demonstrating of gas controlled motor, alert sign, arrange identifies some threat adjacent. IoT instantly triggers inquiries around the protection of individual information whether continuous data about our physical area or updates of our weight or circulatory strain that may be available. Providing energy to this new expansion of IoT gadgets and their system associations can be costly and strategically troublesome, Portable gadgets requires batteries that sometime can be replaced. It accept that the basic system hardware and related innovation can work semi-wisely and frequently naturally essentially keeping cell phones associated with web significantly less endeavouring to make them smarter. People have various necessities that require an IoT framework to adjust for a wide range of circumstances and inclinations. Our primary point of view here is to use the innovation to counteract mishaps and abstain from going in over-burden transports bringing about level burst and losing control over the vehicle. The paper portrays the strategies, conventions, segments, systems, sensors and the engineering for arranging complete brilliant voyaging.

articleTitle: Wi-Fi Based Central Protection Center for Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A microgrid is a localized grouping of electricity sources and loads i.e. it is a small-scale power grid that normally operates connected to the centralized grid but can also disconnect and function autonomously. This papers proposes a LabVIEW based Central Protection Center (CPC) that remotely monitors a grid-connected microgrid using a wireless medium. The microgrid is divided into zones for ease of monitoring. The CPC is capable of continuously capturing the current status of the grid in a zonalised manner. If a fault is diagnosed by the central protection center, then it issues appropriate overcurrent relay coordination to the microgrid network.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Coefficient decimation Filter Bank Module Using Interpolated Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Filter banks are used as channelizers in software defined radio handsets. They extract radio channels corresponding to different communication standards. Coefficient decimation approach is used to generate a filter bank. In coefficient decimation method a modal filter is required to be narrowband which increases the complexity. In this paper we propose use of interpolated filter for coefficient decimated II method. The use of interpolated filter reduces the order of the filter and thereby complexity by reducing a need of number of multipliers.

articleTitle: Symmetric Fully Homomorphic Encryption Scheme with Polynomials Operations
publicationTitle: 2018 Second International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Feasible homomorphic encryption schemes are being proposed in literature regularly, yet the message space is very restricted or limited. This makes the existing schemes costly to adopt for practical use where data is too large. This paper proposes a homomorphic encryption scheme that has very large message space. Polynomials are used to assemble chunks of data and encrypt them. The coefficients of polynomials are the encrypted messages. Addition and multiplication of the polynomials are the homomorphic functions to achieve functions on messages. Decryption and Refresh Primitives consists of single mathematical operations, which makes them fast. This meets the requirement of a feasible FHE.

articleTitle: Development of Clinical Detection System for Tonic-Clonic Seizures using New Wearable Sensors

abstract: This paper presents the development and testing of a new wireless body area network (WBAN) designed specifically for remote patient monitoring for detection of generalized tonic-clonic seizures (GTCS). The WBAN is comprised of four, triaxial accelerometer sensors worn on arms and legs. Commercial medical sensor modules were used as benchmarks to validate and calibrate the wearable sensors data. Each sensor is communicating with Linux based platform via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) network. Graphical User Interface (GUI) was developed using Python Software to display the collected real-time sensors data. A new digital signal processing routine for seizure detection was created using Matlab software. This routine is employing multi-feature techniques based on Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and moving average window to analyze data samples with minimal processing time. The average windowed samples are compared periodically with pre-set empirical threshold values every second on each axis for the four sensor nodes. An alert is generated once seizure is detected at base station where Short Message Service (SMS) and instant email will be sent to the medical health staff. The real-time data is stored in secured medical database for future reference and analysis. The final WBAN prototype was demonstrated using healthy volunteers mimicking tonic-clonic seizure symptoms to test overall system performance. The system is also approved for future clinical trials in Canada, and pilot clinical demonstrations have been achieved.
